    The Harada–Sai step #

    IsIndecMod A M: the A-module M has no decomposition M = U ⊕ V into two nonzero A-submodules. rk φ is the k-dimension of the range of an A-linear map.

    haradaSai_step: if g : X → M, f : M → M', h : M' → Y with M, M' indecomposable, f not bijective, and rk g ≤ c, rk h ≤ c with c ≥ 1, then rk (h f g) < c. Iterating gives the Harada–Sai lemma: a composite of 2ᵇ − 1 non-isomorphisms between indecomposables of dimension ≤ b is zero.
